subject.title: [Feature]: Support Slack Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept an explicit opt-in Slack Enterprise Grid org-install mode in the bundled Slack plugin via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102372, or keep the current per-workspace Slack account model for now?
rationale: The request adds new config surface and changes Slack workspace authorization and delivery boundaries, and the issue has a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide the product/API/security direction.

options.title: Review linked PR as candidate
options.body: Treat the open Slack PR as the implementation path and require config, upgrade, authorization, and live org-install proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to per-workspace accounts
options.body: Keep the current model until maintainers choose a broader OAuth or Enterprise Grid design.

options.title: Reject org-install support for now
options.body: Close the direction only if maintainers decide org installs are outside the bundled Slack plugin scope.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as candidate
recommendation.body: Treat the open Slack PR as the implementation path and require config, upgrade, authorization, and live org-install proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on Slack config and event-authorization behavior, where current history points to recent work by Vincent Koc.
